en: {fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just eat a while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}I did not!! Honestly, as if a girl would eat that much in one day!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}...??? Huh? Did you... know I don't like vegetables?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'd love to try your cooking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Huh, mine...? Wh-what's this, all of a sudden...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Well, I'll think about it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Eat too much and you'll gain weight.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Don't say things like that to a maiden!! Idiot!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'd love to try your cooking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Whaaat. Really? Then another time.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Eat too much and you'll gain weight.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Don't say things like that before a meal!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hm? Sure, fine. We're together anyway, so once in a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Right. Being a hero takes a lot of stamina. I have to relax once in a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yeah. Not bad. For now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Am I? I'm normal. Nor-mal.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Yeah, I will. I'm taking it easy today.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you do to relax?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Today I'm going around town. There are sooo many cute clothes around here!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Rest, then keep up the good work.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}You...!! Don't say that while I'm resting!! You stupid angel!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Right. Being a hero takes a lot of stamina. I have to relax once in a while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}Obviously. I'm not overdoing it. Wrecking my body over this would be just stupid!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0B80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks hard. Why not rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}...... I just took a break... Hmph!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1580}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}I only just started!! Jeez!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1F80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Daily learning is important, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}I know that! But listen! Everyone has things they're bad at!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2980}{n}{spk:E783}{n}...Should I not have come?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}If that's what you think, you know what to do, right!?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Could you teach me later too?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}No, no! I don't have time for that! If you want to, do it yourself!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you... a little angry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}Angry!? Me!? I'm not angry at all!! Is that what you came to ask!?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}I only just started!! Jeez!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3380}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Could you teach me later too?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}No, no! I don't have time for that right now! If you want to, do it yourself!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you... a little angry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}No, no! I don't have time for that! If you want to, do it yourself!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Nothing else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}The breeze feels nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, sure, the breeze feels nice...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But a monster could show up any second, and you're so carefree.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}You don't need to worry about that. I train every day.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Besides, I don't get tired from this much.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Now that you mention it, I'm hungry... But never mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's not mealtime yet. Eating too much isn't good for you either.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I'm not tired at all. But if you're tired, want to take a break?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does being with me tire you out?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sure, sometimes it does get tiring...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But that happens to everybody. Don't worry about it so much.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we hurry a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Huh, you're awfully fired up. But shouldn't you take it easy?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Anything you'd like to do right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Let's see. I'd like a bath, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I train every day, right? Training makes me sweat more than most, so I love baths.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}When I'm training, I guess. Well, it's not exactly fun, but it's time well spent.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah. I try not to blow up over little things. I've got a short temper...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}...That's just 'cause you're not used to walking...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Obviously! There's no martial artist who doesn't want that!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you thirsty?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, not really. Besides, we just had a drink. Drink too much and you'll wear out.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}It's not that I like them. I just wander around and it ends up being a walk.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}What? Didn't you want me to hurry? I'm not even walking that fast.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But if you're tired, want to rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}You can fly freely, so maybe you don't think so, but I bet everyone's wished it at least once.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}When did you start martial arts?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Dunno... My old man had me doing it since before I can remember. I don't really recall.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you plan to be in the future?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Never thought I'd get asked that now. Didn't I tell you? I have to protect the dojo.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8D80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{spk:0080}{n}You can fly freely, so maybe you don't think so, but I bet everyone's wished it at least once.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I just wondered what you were up to.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What am I doing? ...Is there anything to do at this hour?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you for your hard work today.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What's with the formality...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Geez, you're the only one who'd come all the way here in the middle of the night to say that.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I... intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Nah, I don't really think so, but some people might mind.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yeah. I'm about to get a good sleep. It's nice of you to worry, but you're not getting anything out of me.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought we might talk a little...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't have anything in particular.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}More importantly, it's bedtime. You should get some rest. There's tomorrow too.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you dislike talking at night?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't dislike it, but... I don't really feel like talking right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you go to bed early?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Pretty early, I think. Actually, I'm a bit sleepy right now. Shouldn't you get to bed soon too?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Well, that's enough, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}What does it matter! You're not the one eating it, so quit asking!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Well... fine. But don't talk to me too much. It's distracting.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just eat a while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Ugh! ...Don't go remembering every little thing!!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...I was hungry, so what can I do?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Right? Just smelling this makes me even hungrier.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}What I eat is my business! Geez, that's exactly what I mean by butting in.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you careful about what you eat?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Let's see... I skip oily stuff. Extra fat would slow me down.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Make sure you eat plenty.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Yeah. Gotta eat lots of good food and build up my strength.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{spk:E783}{n}{fb:0B80}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Well... fine. But don't talk to me too much. It's distracting.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}...So, what else do you want?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}...Fine, but it really is just a walk. If that's OK, I don't mind you tagging along.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yeah. After a walk, I sleep like a log without a thought. Eases the mind and the body a lot.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yeah, I feel good. Getting to take it easy really is nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Even so, don't stare at me like that. It's kind of... embarrassing.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I wonder if this counts as resting. Well, it's a good way to blow off stress.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'm sorry if you were in a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yeah. Well, it's been a while since I got some downtime. I want to make the most of it.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you decided where to go?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Ha ha ha! What are you saying? A walk's fun precisely because you don't decide where to go.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I decided, it'd be no different from the journey so far.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}The breeze feels nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}You're quite the romantic, aren't you...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's true. The breeze feels lovely...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
